brief: Custom skincare formulas from licensed providers, mostly acne and anti-aging. Free trial, just pay shipping. Needs a skincare-engaged audience.

profile.business_summary: Custom skincare formulas prescribed by licensed providers, primarily targeting acne and anti-aging concerns, offered via a free trial model.
stated_claims: Custom skincare formulas from licensed providers

relevant_tags.why: Adjacent category with highly overlapping shopper interest.
The formulas are custom-made for each user.
The free trial model strongly implies a recurring subscription.
Skincare, especially medical/custom, heavily overlaps with wellness shoppers.

persona_conflicts.conflict: disinterested in subscription-only and self-care-only framing
persona_conflicts.evidence: Custom skincare formulas offered via a free trial (subscription model) for personal acne/anti-aging use.

note_signals.why: Notes indicate a strong crossover with wellness and beauty, matching the skincare-engaged audience requirement.
Users are actively spending on self-care, which aligns well with custom skincare treatments.
Science-forward wellness audience aligns perfectly with formulas prescribed by licensed providers.
Audience is highly motivated by personalization and quiz-based onboarding, matching custom formulas.
Velvetline is a direct competitor in the skincare space and would likely block this advertiser.

profile.gate_reason: The product, offer, and target audience are clearly defined, allowing us to map them to relevant beauty and wellness publishers.
clarifying_questions: What is the cost of the subscription after the free trial period ends?
How much is the shipping fee for the free trial?
Are your formulas targeted toward a specific age demographic (e.g., Gen Z for acne vs. older demographics for anti-aging)?

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.70-$0.99 per click (median $0.84), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
